svg.title: EvoPolis: the commons mechanism
svg.desc: Conceptual resource flow. An allocation rule distributes resources from a common pool to four inhabitants. Each inhabitant splits an allocation e_i into a retained amount s_i and a contribution c_i, so e_i equals s_i plus c_i. Retained resources provide individual benefit; contributions are multiplied by g and replenish the common pool. Total allocation cannot exceed available resources. Exact numerical dynamics follow the published experimental protocol. This conceptual figure omits the pool cap and timing details.
